references.text: The immediate context that introduces the principle of land distribution by casting lots
Reiterates the principle that larger tribes shall receive a larger inheritance and smaller tribes a smaller one
The same principle applied to Levitical cities: more cities from larger tribes, fewer from smaller ones
The fulfillment of the land distribution by casting lots as described in Numbers 4
Joshua distributed the land as an inheritance to the tribes according to their divisions
The census that forms the basis for determining the size of the tribes (פְקֻדָיו)
Ezekiel's vision of a future land distribution as an inheritance (נַחֲלָה) to the tribes of Israel
